name: Team Bulbasaur: Grass Aerial Synergy & Intimidate Breakers
archetype: Grass/Flying hybrid aerial coverage, sleep attrition, and Intimidate physical dominance.
gym_duel_rationale: Misty enforces a strict 2v2 duel. Enter the arena with Ivysaur/Pidgeotto (Grass/Flying quad-resists Mega Drain and resists Water Pulse while sweeping with STAB Razor Leaf and Gust) and Gyarados/Arbok (Intimidate neuters Staryu, resisting Water and dealing massive physical neutral damage with Bite and Crunch).

roster.progression_notes: Ivysaur (evolved Lv. 16) spliced with Pidgeotto (evolved Lv. 18). Quad-resists Grass Mega Drain, resists Water Pulse, and is immune to Ground. STAB Razor Leaf easily dismantles Water foes.

roster.status: Active in Party (Route 4 Purchase & Catch Splice)
roster.progression_notes: Purchased as Magikarp on Route 3 for $500, evolved at Lv. 20, and spliced with Route 4 Ekans (evolved to Arbok at Lv. 22). Intimidate neuters Staryu while STAB Poison/Water resists Water Pulse and Crunch deals heavy super-effective damage.

roster.status: Active in Party (Route 24 & Mt. Moon Splice)
roster.progression_notes: Abra caught on Route 24 evolves into Kadabra at Lv. 16 and splices with Geodude. Combines 90 Special Attack with Rock/Ground physical defense and STAB Psybeam.
Fast physical cleaner for rival battles, Nugget Bridge, and trainer routes. Defiant punishes enemy stat drops.

flex_bench.why_use: Retained from Chapter 1. Compound Eyes boosted Sleep Powder guarantees easy captures of wild Abra and rare spawns.
Route 24 Bellsprout spliced with Route 4 Sandshrew provides electric immunity and dual powder status support.

active_fusions: Ivysaur/Pidgeotto (Grass/Flying starter aerial hybrid with STAB Razor Leaf and Gust)
Gyarados/Arbok (Water/Poison physical powerhouse with Intimidate and Crunch)
Mankey/Spearow (Fighting/Flying high-speed physical breaker with Low Kick)
unfuse_recommendations: 1. Visit Cerulean City Poké Mart and purchase Super Splicers ($300 at any Mart).
2. Unfuse Chapter 1's Tangela/Pidgey at Cerulean Mart counter for $300.
3. Evolve Bulbasaur to Ivysaur (Lv. 16) and Pidgey to Pidgeotto (Lv. 18), then splice them into Ivysaur/Pidgeotto.
4. Evolve Route 3 Magikarp to Gyarados (Lv. 20) and splice with Route 4 Arbok (evolved Lv. 22) for massive Intimidate power.
upcoming_fusions: Ivysaur/Dugtrio (Chapter 3 Vermilion City starter splice for 100% Electric immunity against Surge)
